title: Company Objective Threadmap and Initiative Overflow Policy
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: As we scale, company-level objectives are interpreted differently across teams which leads to duplicated efforts, unaligned deliverables, and unclear escalation paths when initiatives exceed capacity or conflict. Goal: Create a single "threadmap" that explicitly ties each Company OKR to a prioritized set of initiatives, owners, and an 'Overflow Policy' that defines how capacity conflicts are triaged and escalated across Product, Engineering, and Design. Deliverables: 1) Company Objective Threadmap (visual + CSV) mapping OKR -> initiative -> owner -> success metric. 2) Initiative Overflow Policy document with triage matrix, escalation contacts, and decision rights. 3) Acceptance criteria and pilot with two cross-functional initiatives for Q2 roll-forward.
acceptance_criteria: Threadmap created and reviewed: each Company-level OKR has >=1 mapped initiative and an owner
Overflow Policy defines clear triage steps, SLAs for response, and escalation path to Execs
Piloted on two initiatives (Optimize Runtime Cost and Console Observability) with documented outcomes
Stakeholder signoff from Product, Eng, Design, and GTM recorded in the ticket links
CSV exportable mapping available in the team drive and integrated with roadmap tool
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff workshop with PM, Eng, Design. Collected inputs on current misalignments and pain points (duplicated infra work, conflicting timelines).
2026-03-04: Drafted initial threadmap from company OKRs -> candidate initiatives; prioritized by expected impact and required effort. Shared with Eng leads for sanity check.
2026-03-06: Engineering review (ENG-11234) flagged two initiatives that share infra dependencies causing resource contention; added to dependencies list and flagged for overflow policy treatment.
2026-03-08: Design review suggested adding 'customer-facing metric' field per initiative; updated schema to include it and approved by Design lead.

2026-03-10: Defined Overflow Policy triage matrix (Impact x Urgency) and mapped escalation contacts: Tier 1 = initiative owners, Tier 2 = Area PM + Tech Lead, Tier 3 = Head of Product + CTO. Preparing pilot plan.
Next steps: Finalize threadmap CSV, draft Overflow Policy doc for leadership review (due 2026-03-17), schedule pilot kick-off 2026-03-18.
links: GH: PR #4582 - threadmap CSV import into roadmap tool
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Teams may resist reassigning initiative ownership when conflicts arise. Mitigation: Include a decision SLA and retro feedback loop; surface trade-offs in weekly sync.
Risk: Mapping becomes stale if not maintained. Mitigation: Add threadmap maintenance to PM cadence (quarterly review) and integrate with roadmap tool to alert on drift.
Risk: Exec escalation overload. Mitigation: Strict triage with objective thresholds and an 'auto-fallback' to a lower-fidelity plan when capacity is exceeded.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (Mar 2026): Discovery + draft threadmap; stakeholder reviews
Phase 2 (Mar 15-24 2026): Finalize Overflow Policy + approval from Execs
Phase 3 (Mar 25-31 2026): Pilot two initiatives; collect metrics and retro
Phase 4 (Apr 2026): Iterate policy and integrate threadmap into quarterly planning tooling

Provide API to accept CSV import of threadmap so roadmap tool can surface conflicts
